data.narrative:
Newspace Research is a Series B-stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security founded by Sameer Joshi, which has raised $73.2M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two valuation methods triangulate a defensible range. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $73M total raised proxy, implying $139M, reflecting typical Series B advancement economics. The Peer-Median method anchors on the $1.0B median valuation across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. This peer cohort exhibits substantial dispersion, reflecting heterogeneous risk profiles and market positioning within the defense tech sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $118M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $570M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty inherent to this stage and sector: peer valuations span a 10x range, and Newspace's competitive positioning relative to Dream Security ($3.0B) and Harmattan AI ($1.4B) remains unquantified. Capital efficiency and customer concentration merit further due diligence to narrow the range toward the median or lower-quartile scenarios.
